pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: The foreground subject exhibits medium-brown, leaf-shaped patches with jagged, irregular edge gradients. The background subject displays darker, more angular, star-shaped patches with sharper pixel transitions between the dark regions and the light interstices.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light cream-colored negative space is visible. In the foreground subject, pathways are relatively thick with wide, irregular junction nodes. In the background subject, the corridors are thinner and define more geometric, sharp-edged polygons.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck of the foreground giraffe presents a distinct 1D geometric silhouette with high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations, creating a uniform brush-like texture against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two Red-billed Oxpeckers (Buphagus erythrorhynchus) on the subjects: one located on the upper-right neck region of the foreground giraffe and one on the mid-dorsal ridge of the background giraffe.
